candidate.startAvailability: Physical EAD card received. Available to start work immediately, subject to standard employer onboarding and I-9 completion.

hero.label: Made for Whatnot
hero.headline: I am eager to drive growth with Whatnot's dynamic team.
hero.subheadline: Joining Whatnot as a Sales Development Representative excites me because of its innovative approach to commerce and community. I am drawn to the opportunity to contribute to a company that's rapidly shaping the future of social shopping.

whyCompany.title: Innovative social commerce platform
whyCompany.body: Whatnot revolutionizes how people shop online by combining entertainment and retail. This blend of engagement and commerce fascinates me and aligns with my experience in digital strategies.

whyCompany.title: Growth phase momentum
whyCompany.body: As an early-stage startup, Whatnot presents an exciting opportunity to influence foundational growth. Joining during this expansion phase means I can directly impact the company's success trajectory.

whyCompany.title: Sales experience alignment
whyCompany.body: With my BDR and digital fundraising experience, I'm equipped to understand client needs quickly. My skills in cold outreach and relationship management directly support the Sales Development Representative role.

quote: I want this role at Whatnot to merge my passion for sales with my drive to innovate in the social shopping space.
